newsitem.title: FRANCE: Amsterdam agreement confirms euro on track-Trichet.
newsitem.headline: Amsterdam agreement confirms euro on track-Trichet.

text.p: Bank of France Governor Jean-Claude Trichet said on Tuesday that the agreement reached in Amsterdam by European Union leaders showed the single currency project was on track to begin on time.
"I'm very pleased that a good accord could be reached in Amsterdam," Trichet told the French association of financial institutions.

He said the elements agreed by EU leaders at the meeting on Monday were positive. "All this is very important and confirms, if that were needed, that we're on track for a single currency on January 1, 1999," Trichet said.

The EU leaders reached an agreement on a pact to enforce budget discipline after the new currency is launched, which included measures aimed at promoting employment and growth to accommodate demands from France's new Socialist-led government.
